_real_world.class: Large-aperture AESA search/track radar in a dorsal radome
_real_world.variant_scope: KJ-600 carrier-based AEW&C aircraft primary mission sensor
public_equipment: AESA in dorsal radome (institute attribution unconfirmed); array layout not public (OOB page, B); claimed track capacity >200 targets (C-only); claimed detection ranges >400 km vs fighter/surface, ~270 km vs cruise missile, 320 km vs stealth target (C-only, propaganda-grade per OOB page's own characterization)

_provenance.modeling_note: Primary AEW&C sensor for KJ-600 (C2Node) per the task's requirement. No PRC official performance disclosure exists. The OOB page itself flags the Chinese-media detection-range claims (>400 km vs fighter/ship, ~270 km vs cruise missile, 320 km vs stealth) as C-only 'propaganda-grade' and instead offers its own engineering_estimate via the radar-horizon formula for a 9 km-altitude AEW platform against a sea-skimming target (4.12 x (sqrt(9000 ft)+sqrt(target_ft)) ~= 400 km), converging with the higher end of the Chinese claims for that specific low-altitude geometry. max_range here is set to 380 km, just below that horizon-limited estimate and consistent with the OOB page's own reasoning; the engine's smooth-earth horizon binding (since Geodetic Frame P3-A) will further cap effective detection against low targets at spawn/runtime regardless of this instrumented figure, per the schema spec's guidance for surface-search-capable sensors. fov_deg is 360 reflecting the rotating dorsal radome (analogous to the repo E-2D/CSG_US_APY-9 record's rotodome). Scan/track/noise parameters are proxies patterned on the repo CSG_US_APY-9 (E-2D) sensor record, the closest analogous AEW&C AESA in the database; no public figures exist for any of them.

sensor.max_range.note: engineering_estimate 380 km, derived from the OOB page's own radar-horizon reasoning for a 9 km-altitude AEW platform against a sea-skimming target (~400 km horizon-limited detection), set slightly below that ceiling; the Chinese-media >400 km/320 km-vs-stealth claims themselves are explicitly C-only/propaganda-grade per the OOB page and are not used directly

sensor.fov_deg.note: 360 degrees: reflects the rotating dorsal radome configuration described by CASI/army-university and consistent with the repo CSG_US_APY-9 (E-2D rotodome) record's convention

sensor.scan_period.note: proxy patterned on the repo CSG_US_APY-9 record (E-2D rotodome); no public figure

sensor.detection_prob.note: proxy patterned on the repo CSG_US_APY-9 record; no public figure

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: proxy patterned on the repo CSG_US_APY-9 record; no public figure

sensor.range_noise_std.note: proxy patterned on the repo CSG_US_APY-9 record's long-range AEW noise budget; no public figure

sensor.track_memory_s.note: engineering_estimate consistent with the OOB page's C-only claimed track capacity (>200 tracks), scaled to a plausible track-memory duration by analogy to the repo CSG_US_APY-9 record; no direct public figure for this specific parameter

sensor.range_power.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo CSG_US_APY-9 record (radar-equation exponent, not platform-specific)

sensor.aspect_influence.note: proxy patterned on the repo CSG_US_APY-9 record; no public figure

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: proxy patterned on the repo CSG_US_APY-9 record; no public figure
